notes.text: The linked line has Rabbah bar Lima giving an interpretation of the word shegal in the name of Rav. [The later discussion](https://www.sefaria.org/Rosh_Hashanah.4a.9) distinguishes his received interpretation of that particular verse from the word’s usual meaning. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3194&lang=en) lists Rabbah bar Lima under this name.
